sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
On 5th March, Transport for NSW implemented an eastbound closure of Mitchells Causeway after geotechnical assessments confirmed that the eastbound carriageway needed to remain closed due to ongoing concerns.

During the closure, Station Street, Harley Avenue, Darling Causeway, Chifley Road, Mort Street, Lithgow Street and Main Street were designated as the approved detour route (hereafter referred to as the “Detour”).

Following notification from TfNSW Geotechnical Management, the Detour was activated immediately to accommodate eastbound traffic.

The purpose of this engagement is to provide dedicated towing and recovery services to support the approved detour associated with the closure of Mitchells Causeway during the delivery of repair works.

These services are to ensure the timely response to incidents, breakdowns, crashes and vehicle recoveries to minimise disruption, maintain traffic flow and support the safe operation of the detour route for the duration of the project.

The towing resources provided under this contract are strictly for the Mitchells Causeway detour and are not to be utilised for activities outside the approved detour corridor unless expressly approved by Regional Field Operations.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The designated detour corridor for the closure of Mitchell’s Causeway is defined as between:

- Great Western Highway (GWH) and Main Street, Lithgow intersection; and
- Great Western Highway (GWH) and Station Street, Mount Victoria intersection.

The Contractor shall be responsible for providing incident response and recovery services for the entire length of the approved detour route between these locations.

Services may include, but are not limited to:

- Vehicle breakdowns.
- Light vehicle recoveries.
- Heavy vehicle recoveries.
- Motor vehicle crashes.
- Removal of disabled vehicles.
- Removal of vehicles obstructing traffic.
- Emergency incident response.
- Traffic restoration following incidents.

The Contractor shall provide the following towing resources for the full duration of the Mitchells Causeway Closure and Repair Works project.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
The Contractor shall provide:

- One (1) heavy tow/recovery vehicle.
- Continuously manned coverage 24 hours per day, staffing through rotating 12-hour shifts to ensure uninterrupted service and fatigue management.
- Coverage 7 days per week, including weekends and public holidays.
- A suitably experienced, qualified and licenced operator at all times.

The Heavy Tow Vehicle shall be stationed at the base of Scenic Hill on Chifley Road during this period and for the duration of the project.

This vehicle is designated as a strategic incident response asset for the detour route.

The Contractor shall provide:

- One (1) heavy tow vehicle and operator and One (1) light tow vehicle and operator.
- Availability from 7:00am to 7:00pm daily.
- Coverage seven (7) days per week, including weekends and public holidays.
- A suitably experienced, qualified and licenced operator at all times.

The Heavy and Light Tow Vehicles shall be stationed at the Bell NHVR Station located on Bells Line of Road (BLoR) during this period and for the duration of the project.

These vehicles are designated strategic incident response assets for the detour route.

Amenities are provided by TfNSW at this location for the vehicle operator to utilise.
